findings.problem: LeaseWorkflow uses raw primitives (status: String, is_validated: bool, is_sent: bool, sent_at_epoch_ms: Option<u64>) to model lifecycle state instead of an enum or typestate machine
findings.failure_mode: Illegal state combinations are representable: e.g. status="sent" with is_sent=false, is_sent=true with sent_at_epoch_ms=None, status="sent" with is_validated=false, or any arbitrary status string. The compiler cannot enforce lifecycle invariants.
findings.fix: Replace status/is_validated/is_sent with a single LeaseStatus enum (e.g. Unvalidated, Validated, Sent) and require sent_at_epoch_ms only via a Sent variant. Make LeaseWorkflow private with a fallible constructor.

findings.problem: LeaseWorkflow has all pub fields with no smart constructor or parse boundary; raw primitives enter the domain directly
findings.failure_mode: Any caller can construct an invalid LeaseWorkflow at any time by directly setting fields, bypassing all domain invariants. There is no validation gate.
findings.fix: Make LeaseWorkflow non-public, remove pub fields, and provide a fallible constructor (e.g. `LeaseWorkflow::new(id, status)`) that validates invariants and returns a typed error.

findings.problem: mark_sent unconditionally overwrites status and sets is_sent without checking preconditions (already sent? validated?)
findings.failure_mode: A lease can be marked sent multiple times, or sent without being validated. The function has no precondition checks, no error return, and silently allows invalid transitions.
findings.fix: Change signature to `fn mark_sent(lease: LeaseWorkflow) -> Result<LeaseWorkflow, LeaseError>` with a typed error taxonomy (e.g. AlreadySent, NotValidated). Use the enum typestate to enforce a single transition path.

findings.problem: No domain error types exist; mark_sent returns the struct directly with no error path
findings.failure_mode: Callers have no way to distinguish why mark_sent failed (if it ever does). All errors must be representable via the typed error taxonomy per Holzman Rust contracts.
findings.fix: Define a `LeaseError` enum with variants for each failure mode (e.g. AlreadySent, NotValidated, InvalidTransition), and use `Result<T, LeaseError>` throughout.

findings.problem: LeaseWorkflow carries mutable mutable identity (String id) and mutable lifecycle flags in the data layer with no immutability-by-construction guarantee
findings.failure_mode: The data layer is not inert; fields can be mutated freely from any call site, violating the functional-core principle that data is valid by construction and calculations are pure.
findings.fix: Make LeaseWorkflow immutable after construction. Use an enum typestate for lifecycle. Move mutation into pure functions that return new instances, and keep I/O in a shell layer.

findings.problem: No tests exist for any behavior, including the mark_sent transition
findings.failure_mode: No behavioral contract is enforced. Invalid state combinations are not caught by tests. There is no evidence that mark_sent works correctly for valid or invalid inputs.
findings.fix: Add tests covering: valid transition (validated -> sent), rejected transition (unvalidated -> sent), rejected transition (already sent), and constructor validation.

findings.problem: No benchmark exists for mark_sent or any performance claim
findings.failure_mode: Performance claims cannot be verified. The Holzman Rust performance discipline requires benchmark or profiler evidence for any performance-sensitive code.
findings.fix: Add a benchmark in benches/ for mark_sent with workload description, baseline, and measured numbers.

findings.problem: LeaseWorkflow uses bare `String` for id instead of a typed newtype (e.g. LeaseId)
findings.failure_mode: String ids can be confused with other string fields. A newtype enforces domain discipline and prevents passing a status string where an id is expected.
findings.fix: Define `pub struct LeaseId(String)` with Display and FromStr, and use it as the id field type.

missing_evidence: no benchmark exists for mark_sent or any performance claim
no profiler evidence for hot-path analysis
no allocation evidence (mark_sent calls .to_string() which allocates)
no second-ring evidence for any correctness claim
no command evidence (cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo clippy, cargo test) was run
residual_risk: The crate models lease lifecycle state entirely with raw primitives that permit illegal state combinations. The mark_sent function has no preconditions and silently allows invalid transitions. No tests, benchmarks, or error taxonomy exist. This is a foundational architecture violation that must be repaired before any downstream work proceeds.
